name: Rayane Chahine
headline: Solution Marketing Manager at Ericsson
summary:
Over 16 years of International Consultancy experience within Telecommunications with wide professional exposure in BSS Domain and Digital Transformation Consulting. Demonstrated strong abilities at managing consulting projects and providing strategic leadership that enabled rapid growth of Ericsson and PwC consulting practices. I took responsibility to drive and grow delivery teams whilst consistently identifying new business opportunities. Demonstrated great talent for engaging and mentoring team members, handling multidisciplinary tasks, balancing multiple deadlines, while maintaining an organized, yet creative approach. Diplomatic and tactful in interpersonal communication and decision making with an ability to surpass personal differences in order to reach common objectives.


Disclaimer: The opinions stated on this site are entirely my own.

positions.title: At Ericsson M&C OSS/BSS, I play a key role in Solution Marketing, focusing on understanding customer and market trends to position and promote new products, solutions, and services through targeted digital marketing campaigns.
positions.description:
Ericsson Value Architecture (EVA) – CSI Ericson Global Services
Working on delivery of a Value Driven Enterprise Architecture to support BSS Transformation Programs in Sales Strategy through understanding customer needs and accelerating solution definition & delivery. Harvesting knowledge from previous programs to provide Best Practices Repository to define relationships among Strategy, Business Process, Information & Technology Layers; while enhancing traceability between customer needs & solution.  

Project Manager on Business Consulting Team in BSS Transformation Program
Managing the Consulting team for the deployment of a large scale BSS Transformation Program. The purpose of this program was to meet the operator business needs for improved Time to Market, Order to Cash & Customer Experience. An evaluation of operations was conducted and new operational models were developed and implemented focusing on process, organization and tools in an aim to reduce overall OPEX and implement industry best practices.
"Granted Ericsson Recognition Award for responsibilities shouldered for delivery of Business Consulting Team in the Program".

Sales Lead and RA Program Delivery Driver
Part of Ericsson Sales Task Force preparing for program offering for a multinational operator in France and its affiliates in the emerging markets.

Lead on presales workshop in Austria, Czech Republic, Kurdistan, Bahrain, Dominican Republic, South Africa, Ghana and Syria

Development of RA Practice in Ericsson India
Participated in developing and building the RA Practice in Ericsson India. The work consisted on building Ericsson delivery team & setting strategy for targeting operators and subsequently holding workshops with major operators to present Ericsson portfolio.

Project Management
Acted as Project Manager and Stream Lead on engagements for mobile operators in Venezuela, Nigeria and Austria

positions.title: Performance Improvement Consultant
positions.description: Management Consulting and Performance Improvement for Telecom Operators in Europe, Africa and the Middle East. I specialized mainly in Organizational Set up and Operational Assessment & Process redesign in Algeria, UK, Channel Islands, Ghana and Lebanon.

positions.title: Research
positions.description: Process redesign and business plans for the introduction of new control plane technologies to optical transport networks that dealt in identifying the associated cost savings in human power and physical resources.

company.name: Ericsson
company.tagline: We’re leading the next wave of mobile with 5G, AI, cloud, and network APIs, creating an open network ecosystem.
company.description:
The future of mobile isn’t on the horizon, it’s happening now. At Ericsson, we’re building the foundation for an open network ecosystem where industries, developers, and enterprises thrive.

The convergence of 5G, AI, cloud, and network APIs isn’t just a technological shift; it’s a transformation that is redefining industries and enhancing everyday life. Open, programmable networks are enabling real-time innovation and unlocking new business models across the globe.

Imagine a world where developers can dynamically access network capabilities on demand, where enterprises don’t just use connectivity but shape it. This isn’t a distant vision, it’s the ecosystem we’re creating today.

Collaboration fuels everything we do. By working across industries, we’re designing a future where connectivity isn’t just seamless. It’s intelligent, programmable, and transformative.

The shift is happening. Are you part of it?
